posts.text: Celebrating 250 years of America. 🇺🇸 This is about our shared story. We've accomplished incredible things, we've made mistakes, and there's still work to do. I'm proud of how far we've come, hopeful for where we're going, and grateful to celebrate the country we all call home. Happy America 250! ❤️🤍💙 #America250 #FourthOfJuly #4thofjuly #Belmar #fyp
